pages.title: Home
pages.intro: I am a filmmaker and cinematographer drawn to stories that evoke emotion, spark curiosity, and stay with you long after the screen fades to black. Through short films and music videos, I explore the art of visual storytelling, blending cinematic imagery, atmosphere, and sound to create immersive experiences. My work is driven by a passion for crafting compelling narratives, finding beauty in the details, and turning simple ideas into meaningful cinematic stories.

pages.title: About
pages.headline: Jaydeep
pages.description: Filmmaker and cinematographer driven by visual storytelling, atmosphere, and the art of human emotion.
aboutParagraphs: Drawn to the power of cinema to tell stories beyond words, I see filmmaking as a way to explore human experiences, evoke emotions, and find meaning in the details often left unnoticed.

Working across short films and music videos, my approach to cinematography is rooted in mood, composition, light, and visual rhythm. I enjoy experimenting with cinematic techniques to build atmosphere, create tension, and bring stories to life through images and sound.
Whether crafting an intimate character-driven story or creating visuals that complement music, I approach every project with curiosity, intention, and a focus on the story behind each frame.

Through my films, I aim to create immersive cinematic experiences that linger with the viewer long after the story ends — inviting them to feel, reflect, and discover their own meaning within the images.

pages.title: Tether
pages.description: A story-film about trust, deception, and shifting loyalties.

pages.title: Behind the Glass
pages.description: A mysterious encounter at a cafe with a stranger forces a woman to confront a forgotten piece of her past.

pages.title: The Other End
pages.description: A man carrying a mysterious package to an extraction point realizes he is being watched and discovers that his greatest danger comes from the trusted contact on the other end of his call.

pages.title: Still Here
pages.description: Still Here is a poignant short film about friendship and memory, exploring the quiet weight of a long-ago promise that keeps someone waiting as years pass and the world changes.

pages.title: Reverse
pages.description: REVERSE captures a guilt-ridden man's inner conflict as he literally drives backward in an early morning blur of memory and reality, unable to move forward from a tragic accident that took the person he loved.

pages.title: Swapnil & Damini|Pre-Wedding
pages.description: Swapnil and Damini are a couple who wanted to capture their love story in a unique and cinematic way. This pre-wedding music video showcases their journey together, highlighting the emotions, moments, and memories that define their relationship.

pages.title: The Last Ride
pages.description: A guy decides to sell his old bike as he plans to move out of the country so he meets a buyer(a girl) soon they feel connected over the same interest and  ends up giving her something more than the bike.

pages.title: Payback
pages.description: A man seeks revenge against those who wronged him, but his quest for justice leads him down a dangerous path.
